VTS Scoring Log

Simple Peptides

simplepeptide.com · Est. 2023 · Boca Raton, FL · Scored August 2026

Simple Peptides claims "Independently, 3rd Party Testing: Each batch verified for purity and potency" on its homepage, but names no testing laboratory and provides no publicly accessible COA database. The homepage routes unauthenticated visitors to a login prompt - product pages, test documentation, and any supporting materials are all behind account creation. The FAQ mentions HPLC and mass spectrometry as testing methods, but with no verifiable output available publicly, these claims cannot be evaluated. An additional gap is contradictory refund policy language: the homepage states a full money-back guarantee on opened products while the FAQ specifies a 7-day window for unopened items only. Neither page resolves the conflict. A physical address (10055 Yamato Rd, Boca Raton, FL 33498) and phone number are published and serve as the only independently verifiable public disclosures.

24 /100
Low
Third-party testing claimed with no lab named and no publicly accessible COA documentation. Entire site login-gated. Contradictory refund policy language between homepage and FAQ. Physical address and phone number are the only verifiable public disclosures.

Scoring Notes
Marketing claims cannot substitute for documentation
Simple Peptides makes strong testing claims ("Independently, 3rd Party Testing," "US-Based Manufacturing and cGMP Compliant Facility") in homepage marketing copy. VTS scores only what a researcher can independently verify from publicly accessible sources. With the entire site login-gated and no lab named, none of these claims can be evaluated. Claims without accessible documentation are not scored as documentation.
Contradictory refund policy is a verifiable gap
The homepage and FAQ describe materially different return terms. Homepage: "full money back guarantee even on opened products." FAQ: "unopened, unused items may be eligible for return within seven days." These are not reconcilable. A researcher reviewing these pages before purchase cannot determine which policy applies - this is scored as a transparency gap in the Policy dimension because it represents a failure to clearly document what terms a buyer can rely on.
Sources: simplepeptide.com (homepage), simplepeptide.com/simple-peptide-faq/, simplepeptide.com/about-us/, simplepeptide.com/shipping-returns/. All product and COA content routed to login prompt at time of scoring. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only.
